A small blank name badge indicates introduction. Hands take visual priority, no laptops, no books, no conversational speech bubbles, no speaking mouths. Sophisticated stylized 3D editorial render, human proportions, soft matte materials, vibrant deep teal and warm coral palette, cream clothing, inviting soft studio lighting, clean simple abstract background, generous safe margins. This is a decorative cover about signed communication, NOT an instructional diagram claiming a specific RSL sign. No typography, watermarks, panels, borders, logos.
